# ST-1 Steam Turbine Generator: Startup Sequence and Protection (FDS draft)

**Scope.** This draft covers module ST-1 (15 MW condensing turbine generator, Woodward governor plus DCS). It covers startup from standstill to initial load, and the protection functions. Load control above initial load, the generator protection relay settings and the SIS SRS are separate documents.

**Assumptions to confirm:**
- The Woodward governor owns speed and ramp control. The DCS owns auxiliaries, sequencing and operator prompts.
- Tags not in your data are marked `[tag]` and listed in OI-01.
- Provisional values are marked "confirm".

## 2. States and transitions (ISA-106)

State IDs use "S" to avoid a clash with the equipment tag ST-1.

| State | Definition | Entry permissive | Allowed exits |
|---|---|---|---|
| S0 Stopped | Speed below SP-11. Steam isolated. | Normal stop complete, or trip reset | S1 |
| S1 Preparing | Oil, gland seal, vacuum and M-15 soak in progress | Start conditions met (FR-ST1-101) | S2, S0, S7, S8 |
| S2 Ready | All roll permissives met (section 3). Waiting for ROLL. | M-15 soak complete | S3, S1, S0, S8 |
| S3 Accelerating | Woodward ramps speed to the active target | ROLL command | S4, S5, S7, S8 |
| S4 Holding | Speed held at SP-20 or SP-22, or by operator HOLD | Speed at target, or HOLD outside the critical band | S3, S7, S8 |
| S5 Rated speed | No load at SP-28. Auto-sync active. | Speed stable per SP-29 and SP-30 | S6, S7, S8 |
| S6 On-line | 52G closed. Initial load applied. | 52G closed | S7, S8 |
| S7 Stopping | Normal stop and coast-down | STOP command, or step failure response | S0, S8 |
| S8 Tripped | Latched. Stop valves closed. | Any trip in section 5 | S0 (after reset) |

| Transition | Initiator | Condition | Automation level |
|---|---|---|---|
| S0→S1 | Operator | START PREP pressed, start conditions met | Operator-prompted, then automatic |
| S1→S2 | DCS | Step 5 complete, roll permissives met | Automatic |
| S2→S3 | Operator | ROLL pressed, permissives still met | Operator-prompted |
| S3→S4 | DCS or operator | Speed equals hold target, or HOLD outside band | Automatic or manual |
| S4→S3 | DCS or operator | Hold timer done and no alarm active, or RESUME | Automatic or manual |
| S3→S5 | DCS | Speed at SP-28 | Automatic |
| S5→S6 | Auto-synchronizer | Sync windows met | Automatic |
| S1/S2/S3/S4/S5/S6→S7 | Operator or DCS | STOP pressed, or step timeout, or step failure response | Manual or automatic |
| S1–S7→S8 | Protection | Any trip in section 5 | Automatic |
| S7→S0 | DCS | Speed below SP-11 | Automatic. Then prompt to start M-15. |
| S8→S0 | Operator | Cause cleared, speed below SP-11, RESET pressed | Manual |

## 3. Roll permissives

Roll permissives are checked at S2 entry and again when ROLL is pressed. Loss of any permissive in S2 returns the module to S1. Loss in S3 or S4 starts the failure response of the active step.

| # | Permissive |
|---|---|
| 1 | PT-210 at or above SP-06. P-11 running. P-12 in AUTO with DC supply healthy. |
| 2 | Lube oil header temperature at or above SP-07 `[tag]`. |
| 3 | PT-220 at or below SP-72. Gland seal system ready `[tag]`. |
| 4 | M-15 soak complete (SP-10 cold, SP-13 warm/hot). |
| 5 | M-15 disengaged. Speed below SP-11. |
| 6 | No trip active. Trip reset done. Stop valves closed. |
| 7 | XT-301, XT-302 and ZT-310 healthy, and below their alarm setpoints. |
| 8 | Main steam conditions inside the start envelope `[tag]` (OI-03). |

## 4. Startup sequence

**FR-ST1-100.** Each step has a transition condition, a timeout and a failure response. FAT: for each step, simulate the condition, then the timeout, then the failure. Check the state, the alarm and the operator message.

**FR-ST1-101.** Classify the start as cold when the casing metal temperature is below SP-14 `[tag]`. Also classify it as cold when the rotor stood still without turning for longer than SP-15. Otherwise classify it as warm/hot.

| Step / ID | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 / FR-ST1-102 | Classify the start. Check start conditions. Show unmet items. | Start conditions met | None (operator waits) | Stay in S0. Show unmet items. |
| 2 / FR-ST1-103 | Start P-11 if it is not running. | P-11 running, and PT-210 at or above SP-06 | TO-01, TO-02 | Alarm. Do not start P-12 for this. Go to S0. |
| 3 / FR-ST1-104 | Start the gland seal system. | Gland seal system ready | TO-03 | Alarm. Go to S0. |
| 4 / FR-ST1-105 | Start the vacuum system. | PT-220 at or below SP-72 | TO-04 | Alarm. Go to S0. |
| 5 / FR-ST1-106 | Engage M-15 at zero speed. Run the soak timer for the start class. | Soak time reached (SP-10 or SP-13) | TO-05 for engage; TO-06 for soak | Reset the cold soak timer to zero if M-15 stops. Alarm. Stay in S1. |
| 6 / FR-ST1-107 | Prompt the operator to press ROLL. Check section 3 again. | ROLL pressed | TO-07 | Stay in S2. Return to S1 if a permissive is lost. |
| 7 / FR-ST1-108 | Stop M-15. Disengage it. | M-15 disengaged, speed below SP-11 | TO-08 | Alarm. Stay in S2. Do not admit steam. |
| 8 / FR-ST1-109 | Reset the trip circuit. Open the stop valves through the Woodward governor. | Stop valves open | TO-09 | Close the stop valves. Alarm. Go to S2. |
| 9 / FR-ST1-110 | Cold start only: send SP-20 to Woodward. Ramp at SP-26. | Speed at SP-20 | TO-10 | Go to S7. |
| 10 / FR-ST1-111 | Cold start only: hold at SP-20 for SP-21. | Timer done and no alarm active | TO-11 | Go to S7. |
| 11 / FR-ST1-112 | Send SP-22 to Woodward. Ramp at SP-26 outside the band and SP-27 inside it. Warm/hot starts ramp straight from standstill. | Speed at SP-22 | TO-12 | Go to S7. |
| 12 / FR-ST1-113 | Hold at SP-22 for SP-23. | Timer done and no alarm active | TO-13 | Go to S7. |
| 13 / FR-ST1-114 | Send SP-28 to Woodward. Ramp at SP-26. | Speed at SP-28 | TO-14 | Go to S7. |
| 14 / FR-ST1-115 | Check that speed is stable. Check excitation on and generator voltage in range. | Speed inside SP-29 for SP-30 | TO-15 | Go to S7. |
| 15 / FR-ST1-116 | Enable the auto-synchronizer. It closes 52G inside SP-31, SP-32 and SP-33. | 52G closed | TO-16 for each attempt | Disable auto-sync. Alarm. Stay in S5 until TO-17, then go to S7. |
| 16 / FR-ST1-117 | Load to SP-34 at SP-35. Hold for SP-36. | Hold time done, vibration below SP-40 | TO-18 | If 52G opens, go to S5 and alarm. Otherwise go to S7. |

**Critical band rules (test at FAT with a simulated speed signal):**
- **FR-ST1-120.** Never send Woodward a speed target inside the band from SP-24 to SP-25. The targets SP-20, SP-22 and SP-28 are all outside the band.
- **FR-ST1-121.** Reject a HOLD command inside the band. Complete the transit, then hold at the first speed above SP-25.
- **FR-ST1-122.** A vibration alarm in the band does not stop the ramp. A trip is the only action inside the band.
- **FR-ST1-123.** Outside the band, a vibration or thrust alarm during S3 holds the speed. Exit from the hold needs the alarm to clear.

## 5. Protection

**SIS note.** The SIL allocation, the proof tests and the trip-device architecture are in the IEC 61511 SRS or the Woodward trip system specification (OI-09). This section states the behavior. Voting shown here is provisional where marked.

**FR-ST1-200 (trip action).** On any trip, do these actions:
1. De-energize the trip solenoids. This closes the stop valves and control valves.
2. Set S8.
3. Show the first-out cause on the HMI.
4. Keep P-11 running, and keep P-12 under its own start logic.
5. Keep the gland seal and vacuum systems running, except when the cause is loss of vacuum.
6. At zero speed, prompt the operator to start M-15.

**FR-ST1-201 (52G on trip).** On an overspeed trip or a generator protection trip, open 52G at once. On all other trips, open 52G on reverse power from the generator protection relay. If 52G is still closed after SP-80, open it from the trip logic. FAT: for each trip, check the stop valve position and the 52G open time.

**FR-ST1-202 (reset).** Every trip is latched. Reset needs the cause cleared, speed below SP-11 and the operator RESET command. Auto-reset is not allowed.

| ID | Cause | Effect | Latched / reset | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-ST1-210 | PT-210 below SP-04. Voting 2oo3 on PT-210A/B/C `[tag]` (provisional, OI-05). No delay. Armed from step 8 until zero speed. | Trip (FR-ST1-200) | Latched. FR-ST1-202. | Lower the simulated pressure. Check the trip at the SP-04 crossing. |
| FR-ST1-211 | Speed above SP-60 (110%), electronic. Voting 2oo3 Woodward speed probes (provisional). | Trip. Open 52G at once. | Latched. FR-ST1-202. Log the event. Inspect before restart. | Simulate speed. Check the trip and the 52G open. |
| FR-ST1-212 | Speed above SP-61 (111%), mechanical bolt | Bolt dumps trip oil. DCS reads the bolt switch `[tag]` and sets S8. | Reset locally at the turbine at standstill | Overspeed test per OEM procedure. |
| FR-ST1-213 | XT-301 and XT-302 on the same bearing both above SP-41 for SP-42 (2oo2) | Trip | Latched. FR-ST1-202. | Drive both probes high. Then drive one probe high. Trip only for both. |
| FR-ST1-214 | ZT-310 beyond SP-51 in either direction for SP-52. Voting 1oo1 on ZT-310 (provisional, OI-05). | Trip | Latched. FR-ST1-202. Inspect before restart. | Drive the signal to each limit. |
| FR-ST1-215 | PT-220 above SP-70 for SP-73. Voting 2oo3 (provisional, OI-05). Armed from step 8. | Trip | Latched. FR-ST1-202. | Raise the simulated pressure. |
| FR-ST1-216 | Manual trip pushbutton (hardwired) | Trip | Latched. FR-ST1-202. | Push the button. Check the trip with the DCS powered off. |
| FR-ST1-217 | Fewer than two healthy Woodward speed probes while steam is admitted | Trip | Latched. FR-ST1-202. | Fail two probes. |
| FR-ST1-218 | Generator protection lockout (86G) | Trip | Latched at 86G. FR-ST1-202. | Operate 86G. |

**Vibration and the critical band.** Do not bypass the vibration trip in the band (FR-ST1-122). The OEM must confirm that SP-41 is valid there (OI-06).

**Lube oil pump logic (tests: lower the simulated pressure and check each start):**
- **FR-ST1-220.** Start P-11 when PT-210 falls below SP-02 and P-11 is in AUTO. Seal in the run command.
- **FR-ST1-221.** Start P-12 when PT-210 falls below SP-03. Use a dedicated pressure switch `[tag]` that works without the DCS. Seal in the run command.
- **FR-ST1-222.** Start P-12 on AC bus undervoltage by hardwired logic.
- **FR-ST1-223.** Block operator STOP of P-11 and P-12 while the rotor turns (speed at or above SP-11, or M-15 running).
- **FR-ST1-224.** In S1, when PT-210 falls below SP-04 with M-15 running, stop M-15 and raise an alarm. There is no turbine trip because no steam is admitted.

## 6. Alarms needed (no rationalized database was given)

Priorities are provisional. Rationalize them to ISA-18.2 (OI-02).

| Alarm | Trigger | Priority | Operator response |
|---|---|---|---|
| PT-210 low | Below SP-05 | High | Check P-11 and the filter. |
| P-11 auto-started | FR-ST1-220 | High | Find the cause of the low pressure. |
| P-12 auto-started | FR-ST1-221 or 222 | Critical | Check P-11 and the AC supply. Do not stop P-12. |
| Vibration high | XT-301 or XT-302 above SP-40 | High | Hold speed (outside band). Check bearing temperature. |
| Thrust position high | ZT-310 beyond SP-50 | High | Hold speed. Check load and steam conditions. |
| Exhaust pressure high | PT-220 above SP-71 | High | Check vacuum system and cooling water. |
| Step timeout | Any TO in section 1 | Medium | Read the step message. Follow the failure response. |
| Probe bad quality | XT, ZT, PT or speed signal bad | Medium | Call instrument technician. |
| DCS–Woodward comms fail | No heartbeat for TO-19 | High | See section 7. |
| Sync failed | TO-16 expired | Medium | Check grid and AVR. |
| First-out trip | Any trip in section 5 | Critical | Read the first-out cause before reset. |

## 7. Abnormal handling

| Condition | Response | Test |
|---|---|---|
| Bad PV, PT-210 or PT-220 (2oo3) | One bad: vote 1oo2 on the healthy two, alarm. Two bad: trip if steam admitted. Inhibit start. | Force quality bad. |
| Bad PV, XT-301/302 | One probe bad: use 1oo1 on the healthy probe, alarm (provisional). Both bad: trip if steam admitted. Inhibit start. | Force quality bad. |
| Bad PV, ZT-310 | Inhibit start. If steam is admitted, trip. | Force quality bad. |
| DCS–Woodward comms loss | Woodward holds its active target (never inside the band). DCS freezes the sequence. Alarm. Protection stays active. | Pull the link in S3, S4, S5 and S6. |
| AC power loss | Turbine trips. M-15 stops. P-12 starts (FR-ST1-222). After AC returns, the operator starts P-11, then M-15 at zero speed. No auto-restart. | Remove AC in S6. |
| DC power loss | Trip circuit de-energizes. Stop valves close. P-12 is unavailable. Alarm. | Remove DC. |
| DCS controller failure | P-11 keeps its last state. M-15 stops. P-12 and the trips work without the DCS. | Fail the controller. |
| Restart after trip | Classify the start by FR-ST1-101. Always use S0 and a full M-15 soak for the class. | Trip, then restart at three standstill times. |

| Device | Fail position |
|---|---|
| Stop valves | Closed |
| Control valves | Closed |
| M-15 | Stopped |
| P-11 | Last state |
| P-12 | Runs by hardwired logic |
| 52G | Per generator protection (OI-10) |
